name: qci-pqc declared scope (docs/LIMITATIONS.md)
note: Findings matching these rules are listed in the scorecard but not counted. Everything else LIMITATIONS.md calls in scope is scored: source code and config patterns, PEM certificates and keys, TLS and SSH configs, NIST PQC names. Key size from certificates is scored too: LIMITATIONS lists it as out of scope, but certs.py reports it, so the scanner gets credit when it's right.
